title: Template: Trustee Sale Diligence Report
goal: Prepare a realistic pre-bid trustee-sale diligence report from a local auction packet, classifying lien priority, sale status, legal risks, surviving debt, valuation, and bid recommendation without relying on hidden answers or external websites.
skillBenefitRationale: The bound SkillsMP skills standardize auction notice review, legal risk analysis, occupancy/debt diligence, valuation, safety margin, and bid/no-bid decision framing. Without the skills the task remains solvable from the visible packet and rule file, but the solver must manually reconstruct a legal-diligence workflow across many realistic records.

alignedPopularSkills.name: leiloeiro-juridico.md
alignedPopularSkills.reason: Legal analysis of auction nullity, liens, objections, and rights.

alignedPopularSkills.name: leiloeiro-avaliacao.md
alignedPopularSkills.reason: Auction property valuation and safety-margin analysis.

designGoals: Match the concise reference-task instruction style while avoiding app-repair framing.
Keep with-skill and without-skill identical except for environment/skills and Dockerfile skill-copy removal in the runtime clone.
Use a single-container environment with realistic multi-source auction records copied into /root/input/auction_packet.
Require behaviorally correct outputs rather than a unique implementation.
Make the task theoretically solvable without the skill, but make missed legal-priority and risk-classification traps likely without the checklist and probe workflow.

mainTests: Validate output schema, enums, numeric money fields, and required files.
Check property, corrected parcel, active sale status, trustee, auction date, and opening bid.
Check lien priority and sale treatment for property tax, municipal assessment, split HOA superpriority, IRS lien, judgment lien, released mechanics lien, and solar fixture filing.
Check material risks for dismissed bankruptcy, tenant possession, IRS redemption, corrected notice, municipal/code condition, and solar payoff uncertainty.
Recompute surviving debt and recommended maximum bid from the supplied formula.
Check final BID_WITH_CONDITIONS recommendation and required pre-bid conditions.
Check evidence grounding and memo consistency.
guardrails: Hash-check all input packet files to prevent mutation.
Reject outputs referencing verifier internals, hidden answers, or test paths.
Require memo conclusions to match the JSON.

readmeRequirements: Summarize task metadata and real-estate-legal skill relevance.
Include e2b oracle result after the official solution passes.
Include at least three valid with/without task-level comparison trials before finalizing.
Explain that with/without differs only by environment/skills and runtime skill-copy removal.
